criterion: Selects the highest-priority ready job in JobScheduler.pop_ready() (higher priority integer first, breaking ties by submission order).
Holds jobs whose depends_on set contains uncompleted job IDs until all prerequisites are marked completed via JobScheduler.mark_completed(job_id).
Implements JobScheduler.cancel(job_id) so cancelled jobs are never returned by pop_ready().
Adds unit tests under tests/ covering priority ordering, FIFO tie-breaking, multi-step dependency unlocking, and job cancellation.
All unit tests in tests/ pass when run with python3 -m unittest discover -s tests.
